letter.body:
With the time that passed and which we spent together, my love. I gotta tell you that you have become my favorite person. I cant start nor end my day without you being part of it.

If only there was a way to wrap you in my arms, and hold you tightly against me. Just looking at you makes me realize how lucky I got to be to have such a sweet and charming girl by my side, and to call her mine.

Alone a single thought about you makes me feel content, you stole my heart princess. And for nothing on this world would I want anyone else to hold and embrace it. Hopefully all of this managed to put a smile on that pretty face of yours, you mean the world to me.

I love you
